title: agent-identity
description: Wololo agent identity document (DOCTRINE Section 15.1). wololo-broker (goal 03) is the identity authority (SPIFFE); every other component imports this contract. harness is a free string per DOCTRINE Section 4 (provider-neutral, never an enum of provider names). Expiry is semantic, not structural: an expired identity is schema-valid and is flagged by core.contracts.identity.is_expired.
